question: Choose the word that is the closest synonym to the word "aroma".
solution:
The correct answer is: **2) Fragrance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"aroma"** refers to a pleasant or distinctive smell. (सुगंध)
 
 
• **Example:** The aroma of freshly baked bread filled the kitchen.
 
 
• **"Fragrance"** is a synonym for aroma and means a sweet or pleasant smell, often associated with perfumes or flowers. (खुशबू)
 
 
• **Example:** The fragrance of roses made the garden enchanting.
